properties.name: A tenth parameter-name mismatch (add_component.description → Component.purpose) arrives from a third independent source in one day, and is linked to its expensive sibling: the same helper-vs-schema disagreement about a node type's SCOPE rather than a field name. Filed under `resync` because nothing about the system changed — only the design's knowledge of an existing defect — which the enum still has no word for (fact:defect-change-event-has-no-type-for-a-field-reported-defect).
